points.description: Names a convolutional layer in which kernels (filters) convolve over the input image, and an activation layer such as ReLU. Equivalent wording is accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.5 if only one of these is given: the convolutional layer with kernels/filters, or the activation (ReLU) layer.

points.description: Names a pooling layer (max or average pooling), and one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax output layer. Equivalent wording is accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.5 if only one of these is given: the pooling layer, or the fully connected layer(s) with softmax output.
